notes.title: TWIN FLAMES Showcased at Indie Game Utsav!
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that TWIN FLAMES is being showcased during the Comic Con X Indie Game Utsav event, running from April 10 to April 20, 2025! This landmark celebration features over 110 Indian-made and Indian-origin PC games, and TWIN FLAMES is honoured to be among them. From April 18-20, my upcoming title will be highlighted on Steam’s global front page, offering a glimpse into its unique co-op puzzle adventure.

In TWIN FLAMES, players control Savitri and Satyavan in a turn-based cooperative puzzle adventure, navigating a hex-grid world to reach a destination tile. Avoid obstacles, manipulate the environment, and ensure clear paths for both characters in this local co-op experience. The game follows their quest to achieve the Twin Flame state—an intense connection between two souls thought to be each other’s half. Through challenging puzzles, players must communicate and strategize to prove their worthiness for this mystical bond.

Fresh from a captivating reveal at Indie Game Utsav during Mumbai Comic Con 2025 (April 12-13), where players lauded its innovative mechanics and narrative, TWIN FLAMES is building anticipation. Though the game and its demo are not yet released, you can support this journey by wishlisting it now on Steam! Stay tuned for updates on the release date and demo.

Join me in celebrating the creativity of Indian developers. Wishlist TWIN FLAMES today and prepare to test your teamwork in this soulful quest: TWIN FLAMES on Steam.
